Overview, Historical Timeline, Problems & Solutions You may need to work with numbers that are too large to fit in the normal range of whole numbers. Python gives you a way to do this. Python long integers let you write whole numbers of any size. In many languages, numbers stop at a maximum value. When the number gets too big, the result is an error or wraps around to zero. In Python, this does not happen. Python long integers grow as large as needed, limited only by memory. Python lets you store very large numbers with long integers. big = 99999999999999999999999999999999 print(big * 2) # Output: 199999999999999999999999999999998
